notes: Research starter set. Records marked Verified signal use an official source that describes an existing QA/QI, documentation, or data reporting program. These are relevance signals, not proof of an active purchase or a problem. Baseline targets require qualification. Confirm current contacts and procurement status before outreach.

leads.signal: Official department page describes EMS CQI, structured quality assurance and quality improvement, and compliance with applicable standards.

leads.signal: Official EMS page describes a Total Quality Management system with continuous improvement and reviews covering documentation, patient assessment, and compliance with standing orders.
